answer.justification: The patient has excessive, hard-to-control worry across multiple domains (health and finances) lasting ≥6 months, accompanied by irritability, tension, difficulty concentrating, and sleep disturbance—meeting DSM-5 criteria for generalized anxiety disorder. His arriving an hour early further illustrates excessive anticipatory anxiety. It is not adjustment disorder (no single identifiable stressor), social anxiety (no social/performance fears), or normal worry (impairing and disproportionate).
